sources.title: Foreign Ministry: current tourist-visa Group I/II/III framework
sources.officialityEvidence: Bolivia's live Foreign Ministry services page sets out the ordinary visitor framework: Group I is visa-free, Group II needs a tourist visa, and Group III needs prior consular consultation. It does not map any of the 20 residual passports to a group.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas de nacionalidad de los países comprendidos en el Grupo II, REQUIEREN de Visa de ingreso por turismo.

sources.title: Foreign Ministry: Visa Application System
sources.officialityEvidence: This live Ministry visa-application system is an application interface, not a published exhaustive nationality-eligibility or issuance-timing schedule. It cannot establish a route merely from portal availability.

sources.title: Identification Services Bureau: Macao SAR Passport visa information
sources.publisher: Identification Services Bureau of the Macao SAR Government
sources.officialityEvidence: DSI's current passport-authority page provides an interactive Macao SAR Passport destination service. Its displayed category is not an exhaustive Bolivia entry schedule and did not supply a direct current Bolivia result in this review.

unresolved.reason: Bolivia's current framework does not directly map an ordinary Lithuanian passport to Group I, II or III. The generic visitor-visa system does not prove Lithuanian eligibility, exemption, or actual issuance timing.
